chapters.title: No browser to draw with
chapters.say: I could not make your video yet. I need a browser, and here is the fix.

scenes.heading: Install a browser, then ask again
scenes.sub: Every frame of the video is drawn in Chrome.

beats.say: I draw every frame of the video in a Chrome browser, and I could not find one.
The simplest fix is to install Google Chrome.
Or one command downloads a browser just for this.
And if Chrome is installed somewhere unusual, tell me where it is.
Then ask me again, and you will get your video.
